name: James Meier
bioAdditions: An April 2013 neighbourhood guide to Alexandria, written for military families, singled out Waynewood Elementary's principal, "Mr. Meier", as one of the school's crossing guards who knew students and parents by name and was always out around the school (S1). This is the same crossing-guard habit later cited when he was named Citizen of the Year in 2018.

sources.citation: "5 Amazing DC Suburbs: Alexandria Neighborhoods", Military Town Advisor blog, 8 Apr 2013
sources.supports: "Waynewood's principal is Mr. Meier, he is also one of the crossing guards."
